bagPolicy.summary: Average-size bags and small backpacks are allowed after inspection; oversized bags, luggage, duffels and large backpacks are prohibited. The FAQ gives no numeric maximum.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Asbury Park has metered street parking and paid lots on Fourth, Second and Lake Avenues. The venue cautions that parking is challenging during summer.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Stone Pony FAQ recommends car service in summer but does not publish a designated rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue has food service; outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The outdoor Summer Stage has an ADA viewing section; speak with security or event staff on arrival for help. A separate accessible ticket is not needed.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue prohibits re-entry, with an explicit warning that re-entry is strictly forbidden for guests under 21.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold on Ticketmaster.com and at the box office at 913 Ocean Avenue, which is open during all show hours and on summer afternoons from noon. Lost and found is kept at the box office.

gates.summary: Ticket holders may be searched by wand or pat-down before entering; check the concert listing for the outdoor Summer Stage door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
